Outcome.DescriptionText: The silo is full of quadrotriticale, the wheat that grows as fast as you can plant it. Whoever stored it here left in a hurry. The harvest feeds the colony for a decade and leaves plenty to spare. Research Quadrotriticale Cultivation to follow this lead up.

A purring sound comes from the grain bins. It is not a good sound. By the time the quartermaster counted the tribbles the silo was a third empty. Research Quadrotriticale Cultivation to follow this lead up.
